name: Make a how-to video
summary: Teach one thing you can already do in a two-minute video somebody else could follow. The writing comes first: every step is a command, in order, with a time word in front of it.
subject: English Language
makes: a two-minute how-to video that teaches one skill, and the script it was filmed from
topics: Sentence Types, Adverbials, Formal & Informal Language

name: A car gallery with the facts behind it
summary: Collect ten cars around a theme, give each one a fact card, then let the numbers decide who wins: put them in order, chart them, and find the average.
subject: Maths
makes: a gallery of ten cars, each with a photo and a fact card, and a bar chart comparing them
topics: Bar Charts & Pictograms, Ordering Numbers & Decimals, Units & Measures, Averages & Range

name: Design and test a board game
summary: Invent a board game where the maths decides where the good and bad squares go, write rules someone else can follow, and change them after watching people play.
subject: Maths
makes: a playable board game with a written rules sheet, tested by at least two other people
topics: Basic Probability, Listing Outcomes & Sample Space, Relative Frequency & Expectation

name: A stop-motion LEGO film
summary: Tell a three-part story with bricks and a phone, one photo at a time — and use frames per second to plan how many photos the film needs before you take the first one.
subject: Maths
makes: a stop-motion film of at least 20 seconds, with a title frame and an ending

name: A family recipe book
summary: Collect five recipes from your family, write them so anyone could cook them, and scale every one up and down — the maths cooks do without noticing.
subject: Maths
makes: a book of five family recipes, each with its story, its amounts in grams and millilitres, and versions for more and fewer people
topics: Direct Proportion, Ratio Problems, Best Value & Unitary Method, Units & Measures

name: Build a simple website about something you know
summary: Write three linked web pages by hand in HTML, about a subject you know better than most people your age, and make the writing fit a reader you have never met.
subject: English Language
makes: a three-page website, written in HTML, that opens in a browser and links between its pages
topics: Formal & Informal Language, Noun Phrases, Sentence Types

name: A local history walk
summary: Find six things near home that are older than anyone you know, plan a walk between them with a map and a compass, and write the guide someone else could follow.
subject: Maths
makes: a walk of six stops near home, mapped to scale with bearings, and a one-sheet guide telling the story of each stop
topics: Scale Drawings & Maps, Bearings, Compound Measures

name: Record a podcast episode
summary: Plan, record and edit a ten-minute episode with an interview in it — where the hard part is the questions, and the second hardest is cutting what does not need to be there.
subject: English Language
makes: a ten-minute podcast episode with an introduction, a segment of your own, an interview and a sign-off
topics: Formal & Informal Language, Sentence Types, Standard English

name: Products for a film launch
summary: A studio has a new movie coming out and wants things that make people notice it. Design and make a cardboard cut-out, a poster and a third piece such as a popcorn box, through every stage of a graphics coursework.
subject: Design and Technology
makes: a free-standing cardboard cut-out, a poster and a third product for the film, and the design folder that shows how you got there
